title: Recover ROM data audit CLI build
changes: Recover the ROM-data audit CLI compilation previously stopped by ENOSPC using its retained source snapshot and isolated build outputs.
validation: Cargo release build with rom-data-read-audit completed without warnings; independent guarded verification confirmed successful Cargo finish, executable hash and all 845 source hashes.
Earlier EUR Wine timer, Freezeblink and Stardust scene comparisons were already accepted and were not repeated; earlier slot-job and seventh OBJ quota failures were recovered in their own records.
limitations: The build validation unit reported FAIL during scratch cleanup because Cargo created hard links; the build itself exited zero and separate verification passed. Failed unit and outputs remain retained.
This is a cross-build, not a native Windows or new runtime test; broader ROM data coverage and deferred performance measurements remain open.
